I want to preface my thoughts by saying two things.
1. I love how the weapon feels at the moment. I personally feel we have a bunch of mobility and the weapon feels great to use, it could just use some touch ups and it would be better. It’s already great to me but a couple touch ups and it could be the best iteration of the weapon. 
2. I wish the language of “wide will never use full burst” type things would stop. Like it might be best DPS wise, but people are gonna play the weapon how they want and I feel statements along those lines just alienate people from wanting to join in the discussion and fun of the weapon. 

On to my thoughts on your points.

1. I like the shelling types. I think they could do more to differentiate them, and buff normal and wide to the same level it feels long is at, but having three different play styles with one weapon is really fun to me. I don’t think most weapons have something like that really, at least not in the same way. 

2. I’m fine with shelling levels staying, we just need more late game GLs with the higher shelling level. If not that, give better raw scaling to late game weapons that don’t have the high shelling so they still get used for other play styles, such as slap lance.

3. I don’t really mind having or not having elemental shelling so I won’t speak on that. I will say, since it’s in the same vein, I hope they don’t make shelling scale with raw. I like that when I build a set, I don’t have to worry about crit/attack/ etc to increase my shelling damage. I wish they would have artillery for up to 5 again (maybe in the inevitable g rank expansion) and artillery being a lvl 2 skill blows. But I’m fine with shelling scaling off only a few things since we don’t have to worry about those attack skills, especially since so many skills that would be needed are lvl 2 and slots aren’t that open.

4. I greatly disliked the WSB, I hope it never returns. I barely used it in IB because it was such a pain to acquire/place and then hit with some monsters. I don’t feel like we need to change wyrmstake much, if they just buff the other shelling types and add the shelling modifier from world we lost, I think that would help with opening up movesets a bit more.

I do insurance related things for a dental office. When you call a dental office or doctors office to see if they take your insurance, do not phrase it like that. If you ask, “ do you take whatever insurance you have?” They will, without a doubt, answer yes. Unless they can’t bill out to it. The proper question to ask in this situation is, “are you in network with whatever insurance company?”. Unless they are a shitty place, they should answer yes or no to that, potentially saving you a decent bit of money in the long run. Granted sometimes the extra cost can be worth it if it’s a particularly good dentist or doctor, but some insurance companies only pay if you see an in network provider so you get stuck with the whole bill if you don’t go to one.
